parsedVerdict.reasoning: DataGatheringService is in the application layer. Some of what it does fits that layer: it orchestrates the gathering workflow, picks job priorities, applies selection rules (skip MANUAL sources unless they have a scraper configuration, give benchmarks the earliest date) and calls other services. But it also writes Prisma ORM queries itself instead of going through a repository or persistence service. These queries include upserts that use composite unique keys (dataSource_date_symbol, dataSource_symbol), a groupBy aggregation with _count, and findMany calls with nested select and orderBy clauses. Building persistence queries like these is an infrastructure (repository) job, so the file mixes data-access work into application orchestration. This is a judgment call, because the rubric's examples are about persistence in domain files, not application files. That is why my confidence is moderate.
